svg.title: Fictional 15-acre Eco Hamlet site plan
svg.desc: Fictional 15-acre (6.07 ha) parcel drawn to scale in metres, north up. A lake lies along the west boundary and a protected wetland in the south-east corner. Hatched no-build zones show a 30 m shoreline setback and a 30 m wetland buffer (placeholder values). A wooded hill rises to the north. Vehicles arrive from the east at shared parking beside the common lodge; a gravel emergency and construction lane with a south spur runs west past the homes, with crane standing points beside each building. Buildings: Cabin A (permanent, 54.5 m from the shoreline); Cabin B (permanent, 110.7 m from the shoreline); Cabin C (permanent, 34.7 m from the shoreline); Cabin D (seasonal, 143 m from the shoreline); Cabin E (seasonal, 137.3 m from the shoreline); Cabin F (community rental, 78.1 m from the shoreline); Common lodge (shared, 169.2 m from the shoreline). Not surveyed; not for construction.

g.text: Original concept | CC BY 4.0 | Eco Hamlet contributors 2026 | Fictional site; contours, buffers and positions are illustrative
